value.rationale: The originating article specifically identifies non-Poissonian wall escape as a missing transport issue. The result resolves that issue for a solvable constrained model, shows unequal diffusivity at identical mean dwell and surface occupancy, proves sharp fixed-mean ordering and bounds, and shows a measurable full diffusion-versus-surface-turning curve uniquely encodes the wall-time distribution. These are motivated physical inverse/ordering consequences not implied by the known exponential formula.
